description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is not executed.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for incidents where the recovery phase is triggered but no documented recovery plan execution occurs, or when recovery activities proceed ad-hoc without following established procedures. Look for gaps between incident detection/containment and formal recovery initiation.
